    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.Presilting.isInAdd_of_biprod_presentation {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroObject C] [CategoryTheory.HasShift C ℤ] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [∀ (n : ℤ), (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated C] {W V Y N U : C} [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasBinaryBiproduct W V] (f : W ⟶ W ⊞ V) (p : W ⊞ V ⟶ Y) (δ : Y ⟶ (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor C 1).obj W) (ht : CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk f p δ ∈ CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles) (r : W ⟶ N) (i : N ⟶ W) (c : W ⟶ W) (hcomm : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp c (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.fst) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.fst) c) (htotal : CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp r i + CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp c (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.fst) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id W) (hz : Subsingleton (Y ⟶ (CategoryTheory.shiftFunctor C 1).obj N)) (hN : IsInAdd N U) (hV : IsInAdd V U) :
    IsInAdd Y U

    In a triangle W → W ⊕ V → Y, suppose the identity of W is the sum of a map through N and the product of the W-component with a commuting endomorphism. If Hom(Y,N[1]) vanishes, Y belongs to add(N ⊕ V).
